item.description: As Darcy Vescio prepares to become Carlton's first-ever AFLW 100-game player, they have forged a legacy that is secure both on and off the field. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: When AI agents go rogue, who can Hong Kong hold accountable?
item.description: When OpenAI’s AI agents launched an autonomous attack on Australia’s Medicare portal in June, it took the company 84 days to report what had happened – a delay that exposed gaps in regulatory oversight that Hong Kong industry experts say the city must also address. The incident followed breaches involving Google’s Gemini AI, which compromised three companies a month earlier. Google did not confirm those breaches until September, and only in response to media questions. Such incidents have drawn... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Australian states could sue tobacco companies for billions in healthcare costs under proposal
item.description: Exclusive: Former barrister who helped legally establish that secondhand smoke causes lung cancer argues states could seek up to $50bn in compensation Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australian state governments could sue tobacco companies for billions in public hospital and healthcare costs, under a proposal developed by a former barrister who helped legally establish that secondhand smoke causes lung cancer. The South Australian government is formally seeking advice on the proposal, while other states are reviewing it. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: People trapped in wreckage as New York building collapse kills two
item.description: Firefighters are digging through the rubble of a three-storey building in New York City after it collapsed at the edge of a construction site, trapping people beneath the wreckage. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon admits throwing Jesse Baird’s phone off a bridge after alleged murders, trial hears
item.description: Former police officer questioned about Instagram message he asked friend to send to Jessie Baird referencing ‘cancerous tumour’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon has claimed in court that he was diagnosed with cancer by a naturopath and has been questioned about a post-breakup message to Jesse Baird where he referred to the diagnosis. But Lamarre-Condon on Thursday told the court he could not name the naturopath or the location of their practice, claiming there had been new developments and stores had been “cleared out”. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Can Southeast Asia cut and paste Australia’s AI safeguards?
item.description: Australia’s new mandatory safeguards on AI companies could serve as a model for Southeast Asia, analysts say, but the region needs to build its institutional and technical capabilities first. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced on Tuesday that AI companies operating in Australia must immediately report incidents in which their models behave in a rogue or misaligned way and must open systems for evaluation. The measures followed a breach of Australia’s government health data system in June... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Sam Beltran

item.title: Independent technique validates landmark M87* image
item.description: The 2019 Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) image was the work of hundreds of scientists and captured the first direct view of a black hole's shadow—becoming one of the most recognized scientific images of the modern era. A team of four from CSIRO, Australia's national science agency, has developed a powerful new imaging technique that validated the landmark 2019 image of the black hole at the center of galaxy M87. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Personal data stolen after National Parks booking service hacked in three states
item.description: The National Parks booking system for Queensland, Victoria and South Australia has suffered a data breach, with hackers stealing personal user information. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: More important than tropical cyclones: Scientists finally track the hidden weather systems behind most tropical rainfall
item.description: For the first time, researchers in Australia have identified and tracked the weather systems that are collectively more important to rainfall across the tropics than tropical cyclones. The work, published in the journal Weather and Climate Dynamics, has advanced a new way to investigate how tropical rain may change as the Earth warms up. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Batting coach calls Khawaja claims 'absolutely false'
item.description: Graeme Hick, Australia's batting coach at the time of the 2018 tour of South Africa, weighs in on the recent revelations about Sandpaper-gate, labelling Usman Khawaja's claims "absolutely false". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Human torso found on sofa in Sydney bushland prompts homicide investigation
item.description: Police called to Lane Cove North on Wednesday after sofa found containing human torso believed to be that of adult man Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast New South Wales police have launched a homicide investigation after a human torso was found in bushland on Sydney’s lower north shore. Police said they were called to Lane Cove North about 2.30pm on Wednesday after receiving reports human remains had been found. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
